dynamic_pipeline.failure: learner timed out before torch import after authority admitted it

root_cause: Dynamic current-admission pointers are keyed by stable stream ID, while the revised reader initially looked them up by dynamic actor/instance ID. Static keys are identical and therefore did not expose the mismatch.
remediation: Pass the known stable contributor key (stream ID for dynamic, learner ID for static) into the reader and validate the pointer fence against it.
